lead_headline: Restaurant tracker flatlines again — fourth consecutive zero-day sets new detection drought record as liquor board stretches silent streak to eight days

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads for fourth straight day — tracker extends all-time detection freeze as system remains dormant through Thursday. Active pipeline unchanged at 422 leads (211 openings, 211 closures).

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today — eighth consecutive day without filings shatters all records as state liquor authority inactivity enters uncharted territory. 1 application this week (86% below prior week's 7) as October processing paralysis stretches beyond any historical precedent. Eight-day freeze now stands as longest documented gap in state licensing history.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions today pushes BusinessDen citation drought to 24 consecutive days — longest recorded blackout deepens as no media pickups registered since August 5. All-time total holds at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources. Past 30-day window unchanged at 21 mentions as no late-July data cycled out overnight. 24-day void now extends beyond all prior gaps as November media silence enters second week with no breakout in sight.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) — third consecutive zero-zero day drops MTD to +31 (+1.0/day), 90-day net holds at +88. Past 7 days: +28 net (43 new, 15 canceled) vs. prior week's +31 — minor erosion as Thursday-Friday stalls extend into third day. Two-week pattern now shows early-week surges consistently offset by mid-to-late-week flats: Week 1 closed +31, Week 2 tracking +28 as acquisition momentum concentrates Monday-Wednesday. November slowing slightly from October's YTD baseline (+248, +0.8/day) but structural stability intact beneath surface volatility.
